# Readynaz

> Personal engineering and writing site of Yunaz Gilang Ramadhan, focused on software quality, test automation, Java, developer tooling, open-source projects, and original creative writing.

Technical articles describe projects, experiments, implementation decisions, limitations, and lessons from direct engineering work.

Creative writing includes poems, fiction chapters, and worldbuilding notes authored by Yunaz Gilang Ramadhan.

## Start Here

- [Profile](https://readynaz.com/profile/): Professional background, skills, experience, and public profiles of Yunaz Gilang Ramadhan.
- [About Readynaz](https://readynaz.com/about/): Site purpose, editorial approach, authorship, and publishing architecture.
- [Contact](https://readynaz.com/contact/): Ways to contact Yunaz for technical discussion, collaboration, feedback, or professional opportunities.

## Engineering Content

- [Technical Blog](https://readynaz.com/blog/): Articles about test automation, Java, backend and API quality, developer tooling, CI/CD, and AI-assisted engineering.
- [Java UI Test Automation Guide](https://readynaz.com/blog/post/java-ui-test-automation-guide/): Pillar guide for Java teams comparing Selenium, Playwright, Cucumber, Testara, Appium, and AI-assisted automation.
- [Testara Agentic Skill](https://readynaz.com/blog/post/creating-ui-automation-in-5-minutes-with-testara-agentic-skill/): Practical walkthrough for generating UI automation using Testara and an agentic skill.
- [Raksara SvelteKit Migration](https://readynaz.com/blog/post/raksara-has-finally-migrated-to-sveltekit/): Engineering notes from migrating the Raksara publishing frontend to SvelteKit.

## Projects

- [Portfolio](https://readynaz.com/portfolio/): Open-source projects, experiments, demos, and their implementation details.
- [Testara](https://readynaz.com/portfolio/testara/): AI-assisted Java and Cucumber automation framework with reusable agent workflows.
- [Raksara](https://readynaz.com/portfolio/raksara/): GitHub-native static publishing platform used to build Readynaz.

## Documentation

- [Raksara Documentation](https://readynaz.com/documentation/): Markdown syntax and built-in components supported by the Raksara publishing engine.

## Creative Writing

- [Poems](https://readynaz.com/blog/dir/poem/): Original poetry in Indonesian and English.
- [Raging Sun, Silent Moon](https://readynaz.com/blog/dir/novel/raging-sun-silent-moon/): Fiction chapters, characters, locations, organizations, and worldbuilding notes.
